# xterm.js

Terminal emulator used by the GRC Web terminal. These files are copied unchanged
from the npm packages, except that the `sourceMappingURL` comments are removed
because the source maps are not included.

| File           | Package                | Version | License                     |
|----------------|------------------------|---------|-----------------------------|
| `xterm.js`     | `@xterm/xterm` (`lib/xterm.mjs`)       | 6.0.0  | MIT, see `LICENSE`           |
| `xterm.css`    | `@xterm/xterm` (`css/xterm.css`)       | 6.0.0  | MIT, see `LICENSE`           |
| `addon-fit.js` | `@xterm/addon-fit` (`lib/addon-fit.mjs`) | 0.11.0 | MIT, see `LICENSE-addon-fit` |

Source: https://github.com/xtermjs/xterm.js
